description: A brown lace-up sneaker sits on a wooden surface in front of two white walls, with its laces spread out. The left hand and right hand move in to grasp the lace ends as a two-hand object, cross them over the tongue, pull to tighten, then form loops and pass one lace around the other before pulling outward to cinch the bow and finally releasing so the tied laces rest on top of the shoe.
